| **R7** | Picklable functors | **Mostly Met** | Created `_FloatConvert`, `_DecimalConvert`, `_PercentageConvert` class-based functors replacing lambdas. Verified pickle round-trip works. |
| **R8** | findall case_sensitive | **Met** | The `findall()` method returns a `ResultIterator` that uses `self.parser._search_re`, which is compiled with flags set by the `case_sensitive` parameter during Parser initialization. |

| **R10** | Result slice access | **Met** | Added `isinstance(item, slice)` branch in `__getitem__` returning `self.fixed[item]`. |
